errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen jedes Jahr stehen
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are for every two years (1995, 1997, 1999...), not every year.

errors.text_span: Eine schwarze durchgehende Linie stellt die Eurozone dar
errors.evidence: The line for the Eurozone is a black dashed line (---), not a solid line ('durchgehende Linie').

errors.text_span: beginnt bei 65 % im Jahr 1995 und steigt auf 110 % im Jahr 2025 an
errors.evidence: The Eurozone line starts at approximately 73%, not 65%. It ends at approximately 88%, and the trend is decreasing towards the end, not rising to 110%.

errors.text_span: Eine schwarze gestrichelte Linie repräsentiert Belgien
errors.evidence: The line for Belgium is a black dotted line (...), not a dashed line ('gestrichelte Linie').

errors.text_span: beginnt bei 110 % im Jahr 1995 und erreicht im Jahr 2023 115 %
errors.evidence: The line for Belgium starts at approximately 132%, not 110%. In 2023, its value is approximately 108%, not 115%.
The dark blue line for Germany starts at approximately 55%, not 115%.
The line for Germany does not fall to 55% in 2005; it actually rises from its starting point of ~55% to ~68% by 2005.

errors.text_span: steigt dann auf 75 % im Jahr 2025 an
errors.evidence: The line for Germany ends at approximately 60% in 2025, not 75%.

errors.text_span: Eine violette Linie stellt Griechenland dar
errors.evidence: The line for Greece (Griechenland) is light blue, not purple ('violette'). The purple line represents Spain (Spanien).

errors.text_span: beginnt bei 110 % im Jahr 1995, sinkt auf 60 % im Jahr 2000, steigt dann auf 150 % im Jahr 2012 und 180 % im Jahr 2023 an
errors.evidence: The actual line for Greece (light blue) starts at ~100%, does not sink to 60%, and peaks at over 200% around 2020. The described values do not match any single line on the chart.
The line for Spain (Spanien) is purple, not light green ('hellgrüne'). The light green line (dashed) is Italy, and the solid green line is Ireland.
The purple line for Spain starts at approximately 60%, not 110%.
The line for France (Frankreich) is a light blue solid line that starts at approximately 58%, not 115%.
The line for France rises steadily from the beginning; it does not fall to 60%.
The line for Ireland is solid green, not light grey ('hellgraue'). There is no grey line in the chart.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei 100 % im Jahr 1995, fällt auf 60 % im Jahr 2000 und bleibt bis 2025 relativ stabil bei 70 %
errors.evidence: The line for Ireland starts at ~80%, falls to a low of ~25% around 2007, peaks dramatically at ~120% in 2012, and ends around 38%. The entire description of its trend and values is incorrect.
The description omits the line for Italy (Italien), which is represented by a light green dashed line in the chart and is listed in the legend.
